name: Berggasthaus Bleckenau
kurzbeschreibung:
**Mountain inn Bleckenau in Schwangau**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, the **Berggasthaus Bleckenau** offers breathtaking views of **Neuschwanstein Castle** and **Hohenschwangau Castle**. This cozy alpine retreat invites you to savor authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a rustic yet charming setting.

Indulge in hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schweinsbraten** with **Knödel**, and fresh mountain trout, all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking or exploring the **Tirolian** countryside, warm up by the crackling fireplace with a glass of **Apfelstrudel** or a steaming cup of **Kaffee**.

The **Berggasthaus Bleckenau** is the perfect spot to experience the warmth of **Tirol**—where tradition meets the great outdoors. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, this hidden gem promises unforgettable moments in the **Allgäu** region.
